# YouGlass 1.0.0
YouGlass is now ready for its first GitHub release on Apple Silicon Macs.
## Highlights
- Added the native YouGlass desktop shell with dark and light appearance modes. - Added Google/YouTube account connection and persistent Keychain-backed session storage. - Added account-aware home, subscriptions, channel, search, Shorts, library, and history navigation. - Added the native player with captions, scrubbing, playback controls, comments, live chat, likes, saves, and resume position support when the corresponding YouTube data is available. - Added desktop Picture in Picture with corner pinning and drag repositioning. - Added responsive window sizing for MacBook Neo-sized displays, M4 Mac mini displays, and larger external screens. - Added the YouGlass app icon and liquid-glass visual system. - Added Sparkle update support through signed GitHub release assets.
## Compatibility
- Apple Silicon only for this release. - macOS 14 or later. - A YouTube/Google sign-in is required for account-specific data. Some official YouTube API features also require the app's configured Data API access.
